Describe the problem, the final change, and any relevant limits. Link related issues.

## Validation

- [ ] Lint, format check, typecheck, tests and production build pass.
- [ ] Meaningful behavior changes have appropriate tests.
- [ ] UI changes pass the production browser journey and were checked with keyboard and VS Code themes, where applicable.
- [ ] Packaged changes pass the archive validator and installed-VSIX smoke; identity, notices and notes are current.
- [ ] No secrets, generated bundles or local settings are included.
